title: Object cohomology stalks are homology of stalkwise sections
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u+1 [def-pc-scheme], i : X.Opens -> X.Etale any functor between the Zariski open category [def-sc-zariski-site] and the etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], F an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], x a point and q a natural number. Assume HasSheafify with coefficients AddCommGrpCat in universe u+1 and HasExt in arbitrary universe w [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Define E on a sheaf G to be colim over open neighbourhoods U of x of G(i(U)), with the actual restriction maps. There exists an injective resolution I of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and an additive equivalence from colim of the object cohomology presheaf H^q(i(U),F), lifted into universe max(u+2,w), to H^q(E(I)).

source.place: Section 01FT (cohomology over an object); Tag 03F3, proof (evaluation of an injective resolution); etale-cohomology.tex, Tags 03XA and 09AX. Read from the local Stacks source mirror and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F3.

proof.text: Define E(F) as the filtered colimit of F(i(U)) over open neighbourhoods U of x. This is a real composite of sheaf inclusion, restriction of presheaves, and colim; it does not choose an unknown object.

Choose the dense small affine etale subsite: over each affine open of X choose finite-presentation algebras and their morphisms, a set in universe u+1. Its objects cover every etale object. Abelian sheaves on this small site have enough injectives. The sheaf equivalence preserves injectives and exactness, so transport an injective resolution of F back to the original site. Only an existential proposition is asserted; no data-valued definition chooses this resolution.

The sheafified free abelian representable corepresents evaluation, by the sheafification and free-abelian adjunctions and Yoneda. The Ext-versus-resolution comparison identifies object cohomology with homology of the evaluation complex, naturally in each object and its morphisms. Compare Ext universes through their defining localization equivalences; this does not change the coefficient sheaves.

Filtered colimits of abelian groups preserve homology. Take their colimit in the natural evaluation comparison. Lift the left diagram into universe max(u+2,w); universe lift preserves colimits of these diagrams and homology. Remove the lift on the section-homology group with the additive ULift equivalence. This gives the asserted additive equivalence. No henselianity or condition on i is used, and degree zero is included.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleObjectCohomology_stalk_complex
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}} (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (x : X) :
    ∃ I : InjectiveResolution F,
      Nonempty
        (↑(colimit
          (((OpenNhds.inclusion (X := X.toLocallyRingedSpace.toTopCat) x) ⋙ i).op ⋙
            Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 2, w})) ≃+
          (((etaleObjectStalkSections X i x).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
            I.cocomplex).homology q)
